description: DV-style viewfinder camera with dual filters for CardputerZero

store.summary: DV-style viewfinder camera with cool/film filters, zoom and snapshots.
store.description: A full-screen DV viewfinder camera for the M5Stack CardputerZero. It draws a 320x170 HUD with REC/timecode, battery, exposure readout and a zoom bar, applies either a cool NORMAL grade or the warm KARAX film look, takes 1640x1232 stills with the active filter, records filtered 320x170 MP4 clips and can hide the whole HUD with one key.
